name: Fire of Life: New Day
source:
A new year starts at the Oakland Institute where college students return for business as usual. Except, life is anything but usual with strange supernatural events going on. For one young man, the appearance of a fiery redhead shakes things up. For another young lady, she adapting to life after being imprisoned in a pocket dimension for most of her life. Oh, yea...a family of vampires seem to be making power moves that causes concern. A powder keg of supernatural energies ready to explode.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2174780/]Steam[/url]]
translation: 新的一年開始了，大學生們回到奧克蘭學院，校園生活照常展開。但一切並不如往常，奇怪的超自然事件正在發生。一名年輕男子的生活因一位火紅頭髮的女子出現而天翻地覆；另一位年輕女子則努力適應新生活，她大半輩子都被困在口袋次元中。喔，對了……還有一個吸血鬼家族似乎正在擴張勢力，引發眾人擔憂。超自然力量如同火藥桶，隨時可能爆發。[引自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2174780/]Steam[/url]]
